notes: freeze_protocol.py v1.0.0 (stdlib-only): freeze() bundles SHA256 + injected-clock timestamps of protocol, cohort manifest, oracle source, baseline registry and analysis code; freeze_id = sha256 over sorted (path, hash) pairs. verify_freeze() re-hashes and fails closed with FREEZE_DRIFT (missing file, changed content, or freeze_id mismatch). amend() appends to an APPEND-ONLY amendment_log.json; any truncation/reordering divergence between manifest history and on-disk log, or a corrupt log, is refused with AMENDMENT_REWRITE and the log is left untouched. assert_holdout_allowed() gates holdout access on a verified freeze and returns HOLDOUT_UNFROZEN otherwise. Path confinement mirrors agent_protocol._confined_path (absolute paths, .. traversal and symlink escapes refused). 9 tests pass: 3 positive (freeze+verify; order-independent, content-sensitive freeze_id; append-only amendment) and 6 adversarial (tamper -> FREEZE_DRIFT + holdout blocked; history rewrite refused; corrupt log; holdout without freeze / fabricated manifest; missing artifact -> FREEZE_INPUT_MISSING; path escape). Real sample manifest written to research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/freeze_sample.json (freeze_id 25005adfed27d1db...). The report file itself is excluded from artifacts_sha256 (self-referential hash, same rule as SH-repo_fingerprint).
